∀ (j : ℕ) {ε : ℝ},
  0 < ε →
    ε ≤ BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.knot j / 8 →
      BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.EligiblePair BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.coordinateObjective
        (1 / 4) (1 / 2) (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingX j ε)
        (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingZ j ε) (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingG j ε)
        (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingH j ε)

∀ (j : ℕ) (ε : ℝ),
  BfgsVerification.TransportedCertificate.pairCurvature (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingX j ε)
      (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingZ j ε) (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingG j ε)
      (BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingH j ε) =
    6 * BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.knot j * ε + 4 * ε ^ 2

∀ (j : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun ε =>
      |BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingH j ε 0 - BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingG j ε 0| /
        (|BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingZ j ε 0 - BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingX j ε 0| *
          BfgsVerification.AccumulatingKinks.crossingH j ε 0 ^ 2))
    (𝓝[>] 0) Filter.atTop
